titanic.summary: Predict passenger survival from labeled passenger records.

house-prices-advanced-regression-techniq.summary: Predict residential sale prices from labeled property features.
house-prices-advanced-regression-techniq.metric: RMSE between log predictions and log observed sale prices

digit-recognizer.summary: Classify labeled MNIST digit images stored as pixel columns.

store-sales-time-series-forecasting.summary: Forecast unit sales by product family and store from dated historical data.

llm-detect-ai-generated-text.summary: Classify labeled essays as human-written or AI-generated; no generative LLM is required.
llm-detect-ai-generated-text.rules_note: Historical code track: CPU or GPU Notebook, internet off; the separate efficiency prize was CPU-only. Recheck rules for any submission.

connectx.summary: Submit an agent that chooses legal moves in a game simulator; search or rules can work without RL.
connectx.metric: game outcomes used for agent rating
connectx.rules_note: Submission has per-action constraints; do not treat the Notebook session budget as the agent's time limit.
